summary: Round now reads as a restrained tournament ranking sheet at 390, 536 and 1280: contained navy event context, compact round summary, tabular rank numerics and ruled deck/player rows appear in one uninterrupted scan order. Live, ended, open, first-place and unrecorded-deck states remain explicit in text; all available controls and navigation outcomes pass fresh read-only interaction checks with zero external writes.

advisoryFindings.finding: The experiment acceptance copy names score and current-selection branches, but the frozen Round baseline, host data model and rendered route contain neither a score field nor a current-selection state. QA treats these as not-applicable rather than asking implementation to invent business data; rank, player, deck, favorite/view metrics, event status, gold rank and empty-slot semantics are preserved and verified.

networkWrites.note: All probes used new disposable browser contexts. Navigation was exercised only to local detail routes; no non-GET request was observed.

390x844.assessment: PASS: event context, round metadata and the first meaningful rank row are visible immediately; rank -> cover -> deck/tags -> player/metrics preserves a clean mobile scan order.

536x864.assessment: PASS: intermediate width gains breathing room without changing the row hierarchy or creating clipping/dead space.

1280x720.assessment: PASS: desktop uses a bounded readable measure and extra horizontal space for metadata separation rather than premature multi-column compaction.
